To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
CPS can be measured, that it is related to intelligence, but not a part of intelligence, that it can be learned, and that it can be taught.
CPS can be defined by a number of criteria that are not fulfilled by other concepts of thinking and problem solv- ing.
CPS is a new part of cognitive psychology and that it requires complex cognition.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for the assessment of cognitive processes in complex situations and the development of methods to support complex cognition in CPS.
the development, validation, and application of assessment instruments to measure complex cognition in CPS.
the question of how people can be supported to solve complex problems in a complex world.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CPS is a case for complex cognitive abilities.
CPS requires a complex cognition.
CPS is a case for complex cognitive processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CPS is an interesting concept for research in the field of complex cognition.
the concept of complex cognition can be used to describe the cognitive demands of CPS.
CPS is a complex cognitive task, but not a complex cognition.
The main takeaway from our work is that
complex cognition is required for CPS.
CPS is not just another part of problem solving, but a new and important one.
the assessment of CPS requires the assessment of complex cognition.
